description: This file defines the StartedTimer interface, representing a timer instrument in a metrics system. It includes methods for stopping the timer, checking if it is running, starting new segments, registering stop handlers, and retrieving timing and segment information.

classes.name: StartedTimer
classes.description: Interface for a timer that is started upon creation and can be stopped, segmented, and queried.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timer and all its segments, returning the stopped timer.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks whether this timer is still running.

methods.name: startNewSegment
methods.description: Starts a new segment within this timer, with a specified segment name.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Registers a handler to be invoked when this timer stops.

methods.name: getStartTimeStamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the timer was started, in nanoseconds.

methods.name: getSegments
methods.description: Retrieves all segments associated with this timer.

methods.name: getOnStopHandlers
methods.description: Retrieves all registered stop handlers for this timer.
